name: Caroline County, Maryland (United States)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with the great seal of the county, the Maryland arms with a crest, in a ring reading THE GREAT SEAL OF CAROLINE COUNTY IN MARYLAND with the date 1773.
history: Caroline County is a rural county located in Maryland. The flag was adopted on 3 July 1984, according to Flags of the World.

features.role: great seal of Caroline County, with the Maryland arms and the date 1773
